# @brrritscold/testing-core-node

Node-only test helpers — testcontainers wrappers (`docker`) and HTTP interceptors (`nock`).

## Installation

```bash
pnpm add @brrritscold/testing-core-node
```

API reference: [brrritscold.github.io/ts-packages](https://brrritscold.github.io/ts-packages/modules/_brrritscold_testing-core-node.html) · [source](https://github.com/bRRRITSCOLD/ts-packages/tree/main/packages/testing-core-node) · [changelog](https://github.com/bRRRITSCOLD/ts-packages/blob/main/packages/testing-core-node/CHANGELOG.md)

## API

Full reference: [brrritscold.github.io/ts-packages](https://brrritscold.github.io/ts-packages/modules/_brrritscold_testing-core-node.html)

### [`@brrritscold/testing-core-node/docker`](https://brrritscold.github.io/ts-packages/modules/_brrritscold_testing-core-node.docker.html)

```ts
import { … } from '@brrritscold/testing-core-node/docker'
```

| Export                       | Kind  | Summary                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ---------------------------- | ----- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Container`                  | class | Wraps a testcontainers `GenericContainer` for a given image, exposed port and environment, labelled and reused by default, with `start`/`stop` and `getMappedPort` helpers. |
| `FlociContainer`             | class | Floci - Fake Local Cloud Infrastructure (AWS services emulator).                                                                                                            |
| `LocalstackContainer`        | class | LocalStack AWS emulator test container on port 4566, running the given comma-separated services in the given default region.                                                |
| `MongoDbAtlasLocalContainer` | class | MongoDB Atlas Local - mongod bundled with the `mongot` search process, so Atlas Search (`createSearchIndex`, `$search`) works locally.                                      |
| `MongoDbContainer`           | class | Community MongoDB (`mongo` image) test container on port 27017, seeded with a root user and initial database.                                                               |
| `PostgresContainer`          | class | PostgreSQL (`postgres` image) test container on port 5432, configured with the given user, password and database.                                                           |

### [`@brrritscold/testing-core-node/nock`](https://brrritscold.github.io/ts-packages/modules/_brrritscold_testing-core-node.nock.html)

```ts
import { … } from '@brrritscold/testing-core-node/nock'
```

| Export              | Kind     | Summary                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `clearInterceptors` | function | Removes all registered nock interceptors so subsequent HTTP requests are no longer mocked.                                                                                 |
| `intercept`         | function | Registers a nock interceptor for each config and returns the resulting scopes, so tests can assert every expected request was made via `scope.isDone()`.                   |
| `InterceptConfig`   | type     | Describes one HTTP interception for `intercept`: method, base URL and endpoint to match (optionally by headers, body and query), plus the reply, delay or error to return. |
